description: This file defines a Java class 'SavingsAccountApplicationRejectedCommandHandler' responsible for handling 'REJECT' commands related to savings account applications in the Fineract project. It implements a command handler interface, processes commands by invoking the associated service to reject an application, and is annotated for dependency injection and transaction management.

classes.name: SavingsAccountApplicationRejectedCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service component that handles rejection commands for savings account applications by delegating the rejection process to the associated service.

methods.name: SavingsAccountApplicationRejectedCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the write platform service responsible for processing application rejection.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the rejection command by calling the rejectApplication method on the service, passing the entity ID and the command details.
